text_block_list.text:
I brought an injured Gold Ship to the 
nurse's office, but...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Damage minor, able to continue mission. 
Awaiting Commander's decision... 
Beep-beep-beep.
choice_data_list: Repairing the damaged areas comes first
Let's upgrade the program right now!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Rescanning... Beep. Mission execution is 
possible. Requesting withdrawal of your 
proposal.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Heeey!! Like I said, I told you I'm 
totally fine!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Orders from the commander, huh... Grrr. As 
Golshiroid, I can't go against that...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
*Sigh*... Roger, prioritizing repairs... 
Beep beep beep.

Afterward, Gold Ship took time off to rest 
with a grumpy look, but a few days later, 
her injury was fully healed and she was 
back to running wild.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
What the heck... Everything was totally 
fine just a minute ago...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
At this rate, I'm just a complete 
failure... *sigh*

"Whether downcast from the self-diagnosis 
results or not, Gold Ship grew eerily 
quiet for a while..."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Okay. Under these conditions, I request an 
upgrade to the existing workout program.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
BEEP BEEP BEEP... Requesting ice cream 
from the store. Until approved, upgrade to 
Golshi-roid is suspended.

Realizing there was no point in resisting, 
I meekly accepted her conditions, and 
together we revised our training regimen.
